Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly converted the well-supported death year of Alexander the Great from 323 BCE to 322 BCE by misapplying astronomical year numbering and the 323/322 BCE civic-year notation. This “normalization” contradicted multiple authoritative sources (Britannica, History.com, World History Encyclopedia) that consistently cite 323 BCE, leading to an incorrect final answer.
